messages:
ops-bot: [INCIDENT] 2026-12-14T02:46:39Z — Elevated 429/503 responses observed from apac-auth-rate-limiter impacting hosted API (text-gen & embeddings) for short bursts. Automatic retry guidance applied on edge. Status: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/1919999999 :warning:

Kira (oncall): Investigating. Alerts show token-bucket exhaustion across several rate-limiter instances in apac-east after a config push 02:40Z. Appears to be a mis-specified burst window.

Omar (eng-sre): Confirmed rollback of the 02:40Z rate-limiter config to previous stable release. Snippet of error seen in logs:
```
[02:42:17] rl-proxy: token_refill_rate=0, burst=0 -> requests queued -> 429
[02:42:19] rl-proxy: upstream 503 on retry attempt=2
```

Lina (support): Notifying affected customers (APAC list). Draft: "We're currently seeing intermittent 429/503 responses from APAC edge causing request retries for some customers. We've rolled back a config change and are monitoring. No data loss expected." Posting to #support-updates now.

Ben (infra): Scaling up rate-limiter pool and increasing token refill workers while rollback propagates. Provisioning ETA ~3m. Also enabling a temporary soft-quota override for high-priority customers to reduce retries.

Tess (product): Are Dedicated or Private customers impacted? We should be explicit in comms.

Kira (oncall): Dedicated/private unaffected; impact limited to multi-tenant APAC edge instances. Retry guidance and soft overrides are in effect to preserve client experience.

ops-bot: Update 02:51Z — rollback complete, additional instances online, 429 rate dropping. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/rate-limiter/apac?orgId=1

Omar (eng-sre): 429 rate fell from 7.3% -> 0.4% after rollback+scaling. Still watching for any residual 503s due to client retries; advising clients to back off 250-500ms jittered.

Lina (support): Status page updated and customer outreach sent. Sales ops alerted for top APAC accounts.

Ben (infra): Captured config diffs and instance metrics to s3://redwood-incident-artifacts/1919999999/ for RCA. Postmortem owners: Omar + Ben.

Kira (oncall): Current status: rollback + scaling mitigations active, soft overrides in place, customers notified. Closing criteria: 429/503 <0.2% sustained for 10 minutes. Next update in 10m or on state change.

ops-bot: Will auto-post final update when closing criteria met. :white_check_mark:
